name: Lotus
look: Lotus throne barrier from cultivation fantasy. Large translucent pink-white lotus petals of light rise round the character and close into a tall bud, a soft glow inside.
subject: bud

parts.name: MAIN
parts.text: the closed bud alone, every petal in place, with no glow, no specks and no pad

parts.name: PETAL
parts.text: one single petal alone, upright, its outline and shading clear
forms: upright and closed, tall and narrow, the middle petal of the bud
leaning out to the left with its tip curled in to the right, an outer petal of the closed bud
broad and cupped, its tip curling in toward the middle, a front petal of the closed bud
wide open, leaning far out to the left and flattened, a petal of the opened flower
tumbling as it drifts away, seen edge-on, thin and bent
turned over, seen from behind, a little paler

parts.name: PAD
parts.text: the lotus pad alone, flat, as it lies under the character's feet

parts.name: FX
parts.text: the small effects alone, spread out so none overlap: a puff of glowing pollen, rising specks of light, a sparkle

parts.name: LIGHT
parts.text: only the glow of the closed bud, the soft light inside and around it, with no petals drawn

layers.name: SOLID
layers.text: the solid shapes: the petals and the pad, opaque, with no glow, no specks and no pollen

layers.name: FX
layers.text: the small effects: specks, pollen, sparkles and flecks, with no petals, no pad and no glow

layers.name: LIGHT
layers.text: the glow: the soft light inside and around the petals and the effects, with no solid shape drawn

rows.name: INIT
rows.caption: shield forms
rows.text: petals rise from a lotus pad under the character's feet and fold up into the closed bud
notes: only the pad and a few faint specks
the closed bud exactly as MAIN on the parts sheet, as wide and as tall as in every other moment

rows.name: HIT
rows.caption: blow from the right
rows.text: a blow strikes from the right; the petals on that side shiver and flash, a puff of glowing pollen bursts out to the right

rows.name: BREAK
rows.caption: shield ends
rows.text: the bud opens wide and its petals detach and drift away, fading
notes: only a few faint specks left
